title: Study of Purinosome Assembly in Cell-Based Models with Purine Synthesis Deficiencies
author: Marie Zikanova
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.qxfdxjn
materials: (FBS) were obtained from Thermo Fisher Scientific, MA, US. All other chemicals were purchased from Sigma-Aldrich, Czech Republic.

We isolated gDNA and total RNA from HeLa cells according to standard procedures and transcribed the mRNA into cDNA with the ProtoScript®II Reverse Transcriptase Kit (New England BioLabs, MA, United States). PCR analysis was performed in 25 μl reaction mixtures containing Red PCR Master Mix (Rovalab, Germany), 1.5 mM MgCl2, 8% DMSO and 0.4 μM specific primers. We gel-purified the amplification products and sequenced the amplicons by the ABI BigDye method (Thermo Fisher Scientific).
Thioguanine inhibition method and growth curves

Wild-type (wt) DNPS genes were amplified from previously prepared pMAL-c2wt vectors [1, 3] and inserted into the pTagBFP-C vector (Evrogen, Russia). The vector pTagBFP_Y114H_ADSL was prepared by introducing the mutation c340T>C (p.Y114H) into the initial vector pTagBFP_ADSL by using the GeneArt Site-Directed Mutagenesis System (Thermo Fisher Scientific) according to standard procedures. All sequences were verified by DNA sequencing.

For transfection, 1 x 105 CRISPR-edited HeLa cells were transiently transfected with 1.5 g of constructs using the Neon® Transfection System (Thermo Fisher Scientific) with the following parameters: pulse voltage: 1400 V, pulse width: 20 ms, number of pulses: 2, tip type: 10 μl and seeded on 1.7 cm2 glass chamber slides (Thermo Fisher Scientific). After 24 h, the cells were washed and subsequently incubated with purine-depleted or purine-rich medium. After another 24 h, immunofluorescence labelling was performed. PAICS-, PFAS-, ADSL- and ATIC- deficient cells transfected with wt proteins were grown on 6-well plates for 24 h in purine-depleted medium and then tested for DNPS substrate accumulation by LC-MS/MS as described previously [1]. The cells were not synchronized for the cell cycle.

For immunofluorescence labelling, the cells were fixed with 4% paraformaldehyde in PBS, permeabilized in 0.1% TRITON, washed, blocked with 5% BSA in PBS and incubated in a humidified chamber for 1 h at 37°C with the following primary antibodies: rabbit polyclonal IgG anti-PPAT (Sigma-Aldrich), dilution factor 1:50, mouse polyclonal IgG anti-GART (Abnova, Taiwan), dilution factor 1:20 and mouse monoclonal IgG2κ anti-PAICS (Sigma-Aldrich), dilution factor 1:50. For fluorescence detection, species-appropriate Alexa Fluor® 488 and 555 secondary antibodies (Thermo Fisher Scientific), dilution factor 1:1000 both, were used. Slides were mounted with ProLong® Gold Antifade Mountant (Thermo Fisher Scientific) as the fluorescence mounting medium and analysed by confocal microscopy. All immunofluorescence experiments were repeated at least twice.

steps.title: Prepare Purine-Depleted Media
steps.instruction: Prepare purine-depleted media by dialyzing 10% foetal bovine serum (FBS) against 0.9% NaCl at 4°C for 48 h using a 10 kDa MWCO dialysis membrane. Supplement the resulting DMEM with the dialyzed 10% FBS and 1% penicillin/streptomycin.

steps.title: Maintain Purine Synthesis Deficient HeLa Cells
steps.instruction: Maintain CRISPR-edited HeLa cells deficient in GART, PFAS, PAICS, ADSL, ATIC, or HGPRT in DMEM/F12 nutrient mixture.

substeps.instruction: Supplement medium with 10% foetal bovine serum (FBS), 1% penicillin/streptomycin, and 0.03 mM adenine.

steps.title: Perform HGPRT Enzyme Activity Assay
steps.instruction: Measure HGPRT enzyme activity using a cell lysate in a specific reaction mixture.

substeps.instruction: Prepare a 40 μl reaction mixture containing 50 mM Tris (pH 7.4), 10 mM MgCl2, 1.5 mM phosphoribosyl pyrophosphate (PRPP), 1 mM hypoxanthine, 37.5 mM KH2PO4, and 4 μg of protein from cell lysate.
Perform the reaction for 1 h at 37°C.
Measure the concentration of formed inosine monophosphate (IMP) using the HPLC-DAD method (IMP retention time: 10.8 min).

steps.title: Establish Cell Growth Curves
steps.instruction: Seed and monitor the growth of normal HeLa or CR-HGPRT cells.

substeps.instruction: Seed 5 x 10^4 cells in 6-well plates containing either normal growth medium or medium supplemented with 0.03 mM 6-thioguanine (TG).
Every 24 h, harvest the full amount of cells grown in one well into 1 ml of growth medium.
Count cells using a LUNA™ Automated Cell Counter to establish growth curves.

steps.title: Acquire and Analyze Confocal Images
steps.instruction: Perform confocal microscopy and image processing on prepared slides.

substeps.instruction: Sample XYZ images according to the Nyquist criterion using a LeicaSP8X laser scanning confocal microscope with an HC PL APO objective (63x, N.A. 1.40) and 405, 488, and 543 laser lines.
Restore images using a classic maximum likelihood restoration algorithm in Huygens Professional Software.
Create colocalization maps with single-pixel overlap coefficient values (0-1) in Huygens Professional Software, presenting results in pseudocolour with corresponding lookup tables (LUT).
Analyze at least ten cells from each cell type using identical acquisition conditions.
